method: CSS custom properties and rules from /_next/static/css/8f101df136340a6c.css, computed styles at 1440x900 via Playwright (harvest/pages/home.json -> styles), logo colours measured from the PNG pixels (scripts/brand_measure.py, harvest/brand_measured.json)
summary: Light, airy, editorial SaaS look: white and off-white paper sections, deep forest-ink text, one deep green as the working accent, a vivid orange for primary CTAs, lime as a small highlight. Lato everywhere (Black 900 for the hero headline, Bold 700 for headings, Regular 400 for body). Pill buttons and pill nav, 18px card radius, hairline sage borders, almost no shadow. Two-tone headlines: line 1 in ink, line 2 in green.

motion_on_site.reveal: sections fade in: opacity 0->1 and translateY(18px)->0 over 0.7s

components.nav: floating white pill 1152x82 at top 18px, logo in a 72px circle at left, inner sage pill (#F5F7F2) with Home / About Alumni / Who we help / Our approach (active = solid #006B38 pill, white text), orange 'Let's connect' pill with an up-right arrow
components.buttons: pill, min-height 56, padding 13px 29px, Lato 700 16px, label + arrow icon (gap 23px). Orange fill + ink text; green #006B38 fill + white text; outline-light on photos
components.hero: full-bleed photo (career-abroad.jpg, object-position centre 58%) under the ink gradient; centred white type; below the photo a white strip with three audience links separated by 1px dividers, each with a coloured 8px dot, a small grey label and a bold line
components.cards: 18px radius, 1px sage border, no shadow, 34px padding, a 61px white-75% icon tile with a green line icon
components.journey: 4 numbered steps (01-04) on a horizontal route line with dots; selected tab gets a #EFF5E9 tile, title turns #006B38; panel below on #F7F9F4
components.icons: line icons, 1.7px stroke, round caps (graduation cap, briefcase, three linked circles); value shapes are chunky 12px rounded strokes in orange/green/lime (assets/site/svg/)

logo.background: near-white #FEFDFD with faint noise (pixel values 252-255), not pure #FFFFFF

mark_bbox_px.note: the mark fills ~83% of the width; the rest is white padding

cutout.how: white unmixed to alpha by scripts/assets_prep.py, cropped to the mark + 4% padding; checked on #17271F: clean edges, no white fringe

logo.type: monogram mark only ('AL'); there is no wordmark and no 'Alumni' lettering in the logo. The alt text calls it 'Alumni AL monogram'
logo.description: A: a bold orange (#FE6C02) inverted-V / chevron with no crossbar, like a roof or a mountain peak; the apex is softly rounded, the left leg runs diagonally to the baseline, the right leg is shorter: it is sliced off by a vertical edge just left of the L and ends about 120px (19% of the mark height) above the baseline, so the A is open and asymmetric and the L seems to stand where the A's right foot would be. L: a separate letter to the right, built from two overlapping flat colours: a lime (#6ABB24) vertical stem with a rounded top corner, curving at the bottom into the foot, and a deeper green (#028B45) foot that overlaps the stem's lower curve and extends right with a square end. The bottom of the L sits on the same baseline as the A's left leg; the L's top is lower than the A's apex. Reads as 'rising path + grounded step': orange energy, greens for growth.
logo.colors_match_css: the three logo colours are the site's --orange, --lime and --green (within 1 unit)
logo.how_the_site_shows_it: header: inside a 72px white circle (cropped round) on the white nav pill; footer: 100px on a white 12px-radius tile on the ink background; also the favicon and apple-touch-icon
logo.quality_note: raster only, slight texture/grain in the flat colour areas; at 1080p the mark can be shown up to ~1000px wide from the cutout without upscaling

photos.used_on_site: hero background, full-bleed, object-position centre 58%, under the ink gradient shade
photos.subject: Elevated telephoto view over a sunny Mediterranean harbour town that appears to be Split, Croatia (the site does not name it): the palm-lined Riva promenade curving along a sparkling turquoise-blue harbour basin in the lower right, rows of cream limestone buildings with terracotta roofs filling the frame, a Romanesque stone bell tower (St Domnius) at upper centre, out-of-focus pine branches framing the right edge, a couple of white vans at the bottom centre. Tiny, unidentifiable pedestrians on the promenade; no people as subjects.
photos.palette: warm sand, beige and terracotta (#7D6C57, #938B80, #AB8E6F, #E7D4B9), olive palm greens (#5F5C27, #2D2A19), sea blue (#7EAFCC)

photos.alt_on_site: A sunlit European city and river, illustrating a broader perspective on working abroad
photos.used_on_site: Our roots section, 470x510 card with 18px radius, caption 'A broader view of what comes next.'
photos.subject: Golden-hour panorama of a hilly European river city that appears to be Lisbon (not named on the site): castle walls with a flag on a wooded hill at left, dense pastel buildings (pink, yellow, white) with red-tile roofs in the foreground, a wide river crossing the middle with a ferry and a few sailboats, the far shore with a red shipyard crane and low hills, a clear pale blue-to-peach sky over the top ~40% of the frame. No people visible.
photos.palette: peach-cream sky (#E1C9A3, #E4E0CE), steel-blue water (#BDC6CE), deep shadow browns (#211F19, #423423)
photos.resolution_note: only 1100px wide: below 1920, use it inside a card/frame or soften it, not full-frame 1080p
